pages.updated: These pages describe how the 4 BRO store works today. For anything not covered here, contact us and our team will help.

p: 4 BRO is a fashion and lifestyle house for men, women and kids, with accessories chosen to complete every look — watches, perfumes, hand bags and bags.
We focus on clean lines, careful construction and a restrained palette: pieces designed to be worn often and kept for years rather than replaced each season.
The name is a promise between us and the people who wear what we make — to build something lasting together.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: We're here to help with orders, sizing and anything else.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.intro: How orders are prepared, delivered and tracked.

p: We deliver across Pakistan. For delivery outside Pakistan, place your order with your full address — our team will confirm the delivery fee and options for your destination before dispatch.
{feeText}
You receive a confirmation on WhatsApp (or by email if WhatsApp is unavailable). Our team confirms the order, then it is prepared, packed and handed to the courier — you are notified at each step.
You can follow every stage in your account under Orders, or on the Track Order page with your order number and email.
With cash on delivery, please have the order total ready for the courier. All orders are charged in Pakistani Rupees.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.intro: If something isn't right, we'll work it out with you.

p: Contact us with your order number and the item you'd like to return before sending anything back. Our team will review the request and confirm whether the item can be returned, and how to send it.
Please keep items in the condition you received them, with original packaging and tags, while your request is reviewed.
Once a return is approved and the item has been received and checked, our team confirms the refund amount and method with you directly.

exchange.title: Exchanges
exchange.intro: Need a different size or colour?

p: Contact us with your order number and the size or colour you need. Exchanges depend on the replacement being in stock — our team will confirm availability and the next steps.
Please wait for our confirmation before returning an item for exchange, so we can make sure the replacement is reserved for you.
Every product page lists the sizes that piece is made in. Sizes that are currently unavailable are crossed out, and the exact stock is shown once you choose a size.
The most reliable guide is a similar piece you already own and like the fit of: compare chest, waist and length measured flat. Kids' sizes are listed by age.
Not sure between two sizes? Message us on WhatsApp from the product page — the enquiry includes the piece and size you are looking at.

sections.h: Do I need an account to order?
p: Yes. Your bag, favourites and orders are saved to your account so they are available on every device. Creating an account takes a minute.
Cash on delivery is available on every order. Online payment appears at checkout when it is available for your order.
{feeText}

sections.h: Can I see prices in US dollars?
p: Yes — choose USD in the currency menu. USD amounts are estimates for reference; orders are always charged in Pakistani Rupees.

sections.h: How do I track my order?
p: Open Orders in your account, or use the Track Order page with your order number and the email used at checkout. We also message you on WhatsApp (or email) as your order progresses.

sections.h: Can I change or cancel an order?
p: Contact us as soon as possible with your order number. Orders can be changed or cancelled before they are shipped.
English, اردو and हिन्दी — use the language menu at the top of any page. Your choice is remembered.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.intro: What we collect, why, and the choices you have.

p: Account details you give us (name, email, phone), delivery addresses, the contents of your bag, favourites and saved items, and your orders and their status.
We do not ask for national identity numbers and we do not store payment card details.
To process and deliver orders, to keep your account and bag in sync across devices, to send order updates by WhatsApp (or email when WhatsApp is unavailable), and to help when you contact us.

We use only what the store needs to work: a sign-in session cookie, a cookie that remembers your language, and storage in your browser for your currency preference and recent searches. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

We share only the information needed with the services that run the store: image hosting, WhatsApp messaging, email delivery, an online payment provider when you choose online payment, and couriers who deliver your order.
Passwords are stored as strong one-way hashes, sessions can be ended at any time by signing out, and the site is served over an encrypted connection.
You can update your name, phone and addresses in your account at any time. To request a copy or deletion of your data, contact us — order records may be kept where we are required to keep them.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: The terms that apply when you shop with 4 BRO.

p: Prices are set and charged in Pakistani Rupees (PKR). Amounts shown in US dollars are estimates for reference only. The price charged is the one confirmed at checkout.
Placing an order is an offer to buy. You receive an order number immediately; our team then confirms the order. Items are reserved when you place the order, subject to availability.
Cash on delivery orders are paid to the courier on delivery. Online payments are only treated as paid after the payment provider confirms them.
{feeText} Delivery details are described on our Shipping & Delivery page.
Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped. Returns and exchanges are handled as described on those pages.
Keep your password private and let us know if you think someone else has used your account. We may suspend accounts that are used fraudulently.
We make every effort to show products accurately; colours can vary slightly between screens.
